findings.description: The response does not define a Permissions-Policy header. This is a defense-in-depth observation and does not prove exploitability.
findings.recommendation: Select and test a Permissions Policy that matches the browser capabilities required by the application.
findings.title: Permissions Policy is missing

findings.description: The response does not provide a Content-Security-Policy header. This removes a browser defense-in-depth control but does not prove exploitability.
findings.recommendation: Design and test a Content Security Policy based on the resources the application actually requires.
findings.title: Content Security Policy is missing

findings.description: No effective CAA record set was observed. This reduces explicit certificate-issuance control but does not prove mis-issuance.
findings.recommendation: Consider publishing a CAA policy that lists the certificate authorities permitted to issue for the domain.
findings.title: No effective CAA policy was found
